sloka: नात्र कश्चिद्यथाभावं प्राणी समभिवर्त्तते ।तेन तस्मिन्न सामर्थ्यं प्रेतस्यास्त्यनुशोचत: ॥ २.१०५.२८॥
transliteration: nātra kaścidyathābhāvaṁ prāṇī samabhivarttate ।tena tasminna sāmarthyaṁ pretasyāstyanuśocata: ॥ 2.105.28॥

translations.english: No living being in this world can act as he likes. Therefore, no one should grieve for the dead.
